name: Investigate the Blue Recluse
summary: Jennea Cannon asks you to investigate strange invisible creatures in the Blue Recluse tavern. She fears a mana rift has opened there.

sections.title: At the Blue Recluse
sections.body: Jennea Cannon reports a disturbance at the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter. Invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and she fears a mana rift has formed. You are asked to make the creatures visible and capture them in containment coffers. Jennea needs the captured creatures for study.

faq.q: What is happening at the Blue Recluse?
faq.answer: Invisible creatures are wandering the Blue Recluse, and Jennea Cannon fears a mana rift has formed there.
Jennea Cannon asks you to investigate the disturbance at the Blue Recluse.

faq.q: Why does Jennea want the creatures?
faq.answer: Jennea wants to study the creatures to determine why they arrived.

faq.q: How do I make the creatures visible?
faq.answer: The Cantation of Manifestation makes the creatures visible inside the tavern.

faq.q: What does Jennea fear has happened?
faq.answer: Jennea fears a mana rift has formed at the Blue Recluse.

angles.text: As a mage, you bring the captured creatures to Jennea Cannon so they can be studied.
